english.title: Fail to give assistance / information reasonably required by person in the execution / enforcement of the Regulations
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable cause, failed to give **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person who was acting in the execution or enforcement of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018, assistance or information, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..), which was reasonably required by that person for the purposes of executing or enforcing those Regulations
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(2)(b) and 18 of the Road Transport (International Passenger Services) Regulations 2018.
